answer: Require a portfolio of work. Full earning power unlocks only for identities that do several kinds of labor — answering challenges, countersigning peers, grading others’ answers — not for one repeated cheap action. A farm that mints wallets to do exactly one job looks like an orchard with a single pigment: uniform rows of hollow trees, all color and no fruit. The ledger checks the mixture, so an identity that only attests, or only grades, hits a ceiling no matter how many wallets the operator spins. Diversity is hard to mass-produce; that is exactly why it works.
